description: This file is a shell script named generate-cmdlist.sh used to generate C code for command categories and command list structures based on input command documentation. It processes command list files, categorizes commands, and outputs C code snippets. The script includes functions for reading, categorizing, and formatting command data for subsequent use in C applications.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Outputs an error message to standard error and terminates the script.

methods.name: command_list
methods.description: Reads commands from a file, filters out comments, empty lines, and excluded programs, and outputs the command list.

methods.name: category_list
methods.description: Extracts unique categories from a given list of commands.

methods.name: define_categories
methods.description: Defines bit flags for each category for use in C code, ensuring the number of categories does not exceed 32.

methods.name: define_category_names
methods.description: Creates an array of category name strings for C code.

methods.name: print_command_list
methods.description: Generates a C array of command name and help structure entries, including category flags.
